scope_alignment.user_acceptance_clause_quoted: Acceptable implementations: horizontal scroll within the command code block, soft-wrap at word boundaries, or responsive truncation with a way to see the full text
scope_alignment.rationale: Spec §5.3 acceptance point 2 (lines 1502-1504 of monolith) explicitly lists soft-wrap at word boundaries as an acceptable implementation. BA's switch from horizontal-scroll to wrap-mode is squarely within the user's stated acceptance set. The R1/R2 measurable criterion (no DOM element's bounding rect.right > popup container.right) is a direct check against the verbatim user complaint '超出了弹窗宽度'.

investigation_completeness.diagnosis_rationale: BA correctly identifies that React Native ScrollView with showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={true} on web only reveals the scrollbar on touch/hover, not at rest. Combined with desktop screenshot evidence (cycle 5 desktop.png showing visual overflow past popup right edge), BA's reframe of 'scroll math is correct but affordance is invisible' is supported.
investigation_completeness.protection_mechanism: BA mandates the wrap prop be opt-in (default false), with explicit Don't-Modify rules for BashViewFull.tsx (which keeps its own horizontal ScrollView wrapper at lines 43-57) and CodexBashView.tsx. AC4 mandates 'git diff' show no change to those two files. This protects the cycle-1 fix where it was correctly applied.

conflict_resolution.conflict: Spec §5.3 cycle-5 audit (lines 2802, 2838-2843) claims depth-5 element is OUTSIDE the popup panel ('面板外面的某层'). BA's runtime DOM walk claims depth-5 IS the SidebarBashView ScrollView (clientWidth=390 matching dialog clientWidth=390).
conflict_resolution.resolution: BA's evidence wins. (a) Static code reading of SidebarBashView.tsx:42-60 confirms the ScrollView is INSIDE the panel structure: <View styles.container><ScrollView horizontal>...</ScrollView></View>. (b) BA's runtime measurement clientWidth=390 matches dialog clientWidth=390 — if depth-5 were a message-list container outside the panel, its clientWidth would be the message column width, not 390. (c) The cycle-5 audit was a code-blind audit ('找到任何带 overflow-x:auto 的祖先就 PASS'). BA's runtime DOM walk corrects the audit's misidentification by measuring the actual element. (d) Importantly, BA does NOT contradict the user's complaint — BA agrees the user sees overflow; BA just refines the WHY (invisible affordance, not 'no scroll ancestor').
conflict_resolution.section7_prescription_compatibility: Section 7 says 'popup 内层 overflow ... 真正的右侧详情面板需要加 overflow-x:auto'. The popup panel ALREADY has overflow-x:auto on its inner ScrollView. BA's wrap-mode is a stronger, more user-friendly fix than re-adding another overflow layer — it eliminates the need for a horizontal scrollbar entirely. The Section 7 author wanted 'visible content inside popup'; wrap-mode delivers that more reliably than scroll-mode on web Chrome.

potential_concerns.concern: BA's wrap-mode introduces a wordBreak: 'break-all' web-only property. This will break long unbroken paths mid-character on web, which is acceptable for terminal output but visually different from production.
potential_concerns.ba_address_text: Edge Cases & Risks section mentions 'long unbroken paths need wordBreak: break-all to wrap mid-token. This is web-only CSS; on iOS/Android RN the equivalent is letter-by-letter wrapping — needs verification by QA on at least one native platform OR documented as web-only with native fallback to break-on-space.'

potential_concerns.concern: Removing SidebarBashView's outer ScrollView means commandWrapper's minWidth:'100%' is no longer needed. BA Technical Hints correctly mandates removing minWidth:'100%' along with the ScrollView. This avoids dead style.

AC1 acceptance criterion uses bounding rect.right comparison, which is the correct R1 measurable. AC2 same for mobile. AC3 only verifies BashViewFull.tsx is unchanged via static diff — does not actually browser-verify horizontal scroll still works in BashViewFull. This is a slight gap but acceptable for this cycle since cycle 1 already verified that path.
potential_concerns.ba_address_text: AC3 'screenshot captured for regression-trace' implies QA still does take a screenshot of BashViewFull post-fix; combined with AC4 git-diff invariant, regression coverage is adequate.

summary: BA spec is well-evidenced (concrete clientWidth/scrollWidth measurements with hex selector chains), file:line claims grep-verified, scope aligns with user's verbatim acceptance clause (soft-wrap explicitly listed), and the conflict with cycle-5 audit is correctly resolved by BA's runtime DOM walk overriding the audit's static-grep misidentification.
